description: StarCi Academy backend — port offset registry + stack metadata. Host port = basePorts.<name> + portOffset. StarCi uses offset 1; sibling projects use their own offsets. This file is the only source of truth for ports: compose fragments interpolate them and scripts/sync.mjs writes them into the generated env bridge. NOTE: this is not .mount/config/metadata.json, which is i18n content read by the app.

data.description: Private seed-content repo (courses, coding problems, achievements, changelog, advertisements, mock-interview-eq). Replaces .mount/data. No "ref" on purpose: clone the repo default branch.
